Setup
PracticePlayer drew 7 cards for the opening hand.
PracticeOpponent drew 7 cards for the opening hand.
PracticeOpponent decided to go second.
Turn # 1 - PracticePlayer's Turn
PracticePlayer played Dreepy to the Active Spot.
PracticePlayer played Drakloak to the Bench.
PracticePlayer attached Psychic Energy to Dreepy.
PracticePlayer ended their turn.
Turn # 2 - PracticeOpponent's Turn
PracticeOpponent played Charmander to the Active Spot.
PracticeOpponent played Pidgey to the Bench.
PracticeOpponent attached Fire Energy to Charmander.
PracticeOpponent ended their turn.
Turn # 3 - PracticePlayer's Turn
PracticePlayer evolved Dreepy into Dragapult ex.
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex used Phantom Dive for 200 damage.
PracticeOpponent's Charmander was Knocked Out!
PracticePlayer took a Prize card.
PracticePlayer ended their turn.
Turn # 4 - PracticeOpponent's Turn
PracticeOpponent evolved Pidgey into Pidgeot ex.
PracticeOpponent played Charizard ex to the Bench.
PracticeOpponent's Pidgeot ex is now in the Active Spot.
PracticeOpponent's Pidgeot ex used Blustery Wind for 120 damage.
PracticeOpponent ended their turn.
Turn # 5 - PracticePlayer's Turn
PracticePlayer played Dusknoir to the Bench.
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex used Phantom Dive for 200 damage.
PracticeOpponent's Pidgeot ex was Knocked Out!
PracticePlayer took 2 Prize cards.
PracticePlayer ended their turn.
Turn # 6 - PracticeOpponent's Turn
PracticeOpponent's Charizard ex is now in the Active Spot.
PracticeOpponent attached Fire Energy to Charizard ex.
PracticeOpponent's Charizard ex used Burning Darkness for 270 damage.
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex was Knocked Out!
PracticeOpponent took 2 Prize cards.
PracticeOpponent ended their turn.
Turn # 7 - PracticePlayer's Turn
PracticePlayer's Drakloak is now in the Active Spot.
PracticePlayer played Dragapult ex to the Bench.
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex is now in the Active Spot.
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex used Phantom Dive for 200 damage.
PracticeOpponent's Charizard ex was Knocked Out!
PracticePlayer took 2 Prize cards.
PracticePlayer ended their turn.
Turn # 8 - PracticeOpponent's Turn
PracticeOpponent played Rotom V to the Active Spot.
PracticeOpponent ended their turn.
Turn # 9 - PracticePlayer's Turn
PracticePlayer's Dragapult ex used Phantom Dive for 200 damage.
PracticeOpponent's Rotom V was Knocked Out!
PracticePlayer took a Prize card.
PracticePlayer wins.
